2.title: The problem
slots: You post every week, and your content still brings you no clients.
Every piece starts from zero. One week it's a tip. The next it's something you saw another owner do.
A stranger could watch three of your videos and still not say what you do.
You look and sound like everyone else in your field.
You post for two weeks, then you stop, because nobody is keeping you on track.
Posting more won't fix it. Your content goes wrong before the camera is on, because three things were never decided: what you want to be known for, how your content looks, and what each piece is for.
Those are decisions about direction. Until someone makes them, every hour you spend filming is a guess.

3.title: What we believe
slots: Six things we hold to on every piece.
It starts from what you lived.
Your story, your clients, your words. Nothing is invented, and no number is rounded up.
The topic matters more than the hook.
A weak topic can't be saved by a clever opening line or a good edit.
Your offer matters. The person behind it is why they stay.
Broad content gets views and no buyers. Views from the wrong people aren't wins.
We never test on a client. New ideas get tried on our own account first.
If anyone in your field could post the piece, it fails, and we find the line only you would say.
Each of these is a decision someone has to make before you film. Making them, and holding every piece to them, is creative direction, and it's the work we do.

4.title: The framework
slots: The Show: three things settled, in order, before you film.

What people come back to is a show: a person they know, a world they recognize, and a next episode worth watching. So we build your content the way a show is built. Three things get settled in order, and you approve each one before the next begins.
One 45-minute interview on day 1, about your work, your clients and how you got here. Everything after it is built from what you said.
Who the show follows: you, and the one thing you want to be known for.
We decide it with you, from your interview, and put it in writing. After this, a stranger can tell what you do from one piece.
How your content looks, so one frame is enough to know it's you.
Your Visual Identity System and your Profile Audit & Optimization
Your colors, your fonts, how you're framed and lit in the places you already work, and a profile that tells a visitor what you do and what to do next.
What each piece is about, and the job it does.
Your Content Strategy, then your ready-to-film content pieces
We plan all 12 weeks first, so every piece has its topic, its format and its job before it exists. Then each line of the plan becomes a piece you can film.
Each piece arrives with what you say, what you show shot by shot, what's on screen and the caption. You film it. Then we read how your first pieces did, and that shapes what comes next.
Every piece points back to a line in your Brand Strategy, and that line points back to something you lived. When that chain holds, the piece is directed.

10.title: Guarantee
slots: Your Brand Strategy arrives by day 7. If you're not happy with it, for any reason, send me one message within 3 days of receiving it. I refund every dollar within 5 working days, and you keep the document.
I put the refund there on purpose. The Brand Strategy is the first real work you see, and every piece is built on it. So you judge the work before most of the 12 weeks have happened.
What I don't guarantee is followers, views or sales. We control the direction and the pieces. You control the filming and the posting.

12.title: Questions
slots: What owners ask me before they start.
How much of my time does it take?

One 45-minute interview, with nothing to prepare. Then you read what we send and answer within 3 days. You film in sittings of 6 pieces or fewer, about 4 for 24 pieces. One 20-minute setup call, and two 15-minute calls in week 4 and week 8. Editing and posting stay with you or your editor.

You don't need to be good on camera. Each piece tells you what to show, shot by shot, and comes with a card of the points to say. A line you'd say to a client is easier to say than one you invent in front of a camera, and these come from your own stories.
Will this work for my kind of business?
If you sell a service or your expertise with your own face, yes. Your content comes from your story, whatever your field. If it doesn't fit, I say so on the call.
I've posted before and it didn't work.

Posting more won't fix it. Three things were never decided: what you want to be known for, how your content looks, and what each piece is for. We decide them with you before the first piece exists. And so you don't stop after two weeks, every delivery has a date, I write to you every Monday, and we talk in week 4 and week 8.
You're new. How do I know it's any good?

You're right to ask. I won't show you results I don't have yet, so you see the work before you risk anything: your one-page audit on our call, then your Brand Strategy on day 7. If you're not happy with it, every dollar comes back and you keep the document.
Can't I do this myself, with ChatGPT or a freelancer?

You can get words that way. What you won't get is the direction behind them: someone deciding what you're known for, setting one look, giving every piece its job, and reviewing each one before you film. That is the work we do, starting from a 45-minute interview with you. Once that direction exists, {product} lets you keep working inside it on your own. That's why it comes with Season One and doesn't replace it.
Do you write my content for me?
We direct it, and we prepare every piece from your own stories and your own words. You never start from a blank page, and you approve every piece before you film it.
What if I don't like a piece?
Tell me what's off and we rework it. You approve every piece before you film it, and each one is built from your own words, so it starts close to how you talk.

You keep everything: your strategy, your look, your plan, every piece and {product}. I stay available for 30 more days, and your client area and the community stay yours. A second season isn't on sale yet. When it is, it builds on what you already own, and a founding client keeps the founding price if it starts within 30 days of the first one's end.
